recognize_zh: 中倍（20x）H&E 骨髓切片，左上方大片淡粉紅色區域由大型細胞組成，細胞質豐富、帶細條紋，核小而偏心，呈片狀浸潤，即 Gaucher 細胞；右側為深紫色密集的造血細胞與數顆巨核細胞，兩者分界清楚。
features: Large polygonal to spindled cells with abundant pale eosinophilic, finely striated cytoplasm and small eccentric bland nuclei
Cells form a confluent interstitial sheet at the upper left and extend into the hematopoietic areas
Adjacent hypercellular hematopoietic marrow with granulocytic and erythroid precursors and several megakaryocytes
Bony trabeculae at the right edge and bottom
No granulomas, necrosis or atypical mitoses
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes. There is an extensive interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate of large histiocytic cells with abundant pale eosinophilic, finely fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric bland nuclei. No granulomas, necrosis or cytologic atypia are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by Gaucher cells.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells accompany CML, myeloma or mycobacterial infection, and the background disease and normal glucocerebrosidase activity separate them.
Mast cell lesions are spindled aggregates with eosinophils and fibrosis that are tryptase, CD117 and CD25 positive.
Epithelioid histiocytes form compact granulomas with multinucleated giant cells and lymphocyte cuffs, lacking striated abundant cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive, cytokeratin positive and have atypical nuclei, whereas Gaucher cells are CD68 positive with bland nuclei.
